title: Corey's Way (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 102bpm walking bass brushed drums honest character portrait unhurried family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey does things his own way — this has always been the fact
He doesn't announce the plan and doesn't over-explain the act
He just arrives at the finished thing from some direction not predicted
And everyone looks at the result and says — that's well constructed

[Pre-Chorus]
I tried to follow his logic once from problem back to solution
He said "you're overcomplicating it Dad" — and that was the conclusion

[Chorus]
Corey's way, Corey's way
Not the obvious direction but it gets there on the day
Corey's way, Corey's way
He looks at what's needed and he figures out the play
Corey's way is not the way I'd do it
But it works and that's the part I never argue with
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
He's practical with his hands and practical with his thinking
There's no gap between the planning and the doing and the linking
He doesn't need to be the loudest or the first one through the door
He just needs the job to be done right — that's what Corey's for

[Bridge]
Between the live wire energy of Pete and Joel's steady quiet
Corey holds the middle ground without any need to riot
About his place — he knows his place and he is at his place
And the family runs because Corey holds the space

[Outro]
Corey's way is working… always has been…
That's my boy
